facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; Mexico has no foreign-exchange controls.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Rarely: dollar accounts are limited to border-area residents and companies.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Stripe accepts individuals with a personal RFC; payouts go to an MXN bank account.
facts.L1_registration: No company needed; register in the RFC as a persona física.
facts.L2_tax_id: RFC; get it online with your CURP if you're 18 or older.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed; under MXN 3.5m a year, RESICO charges just 1–2.5%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 16% IVA; only listed exported services get 0%, others pay 16%.
facts.L5_data_protection: New data law (March 2025): privacy notice and consent required.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel within 5 business days of delivery (PROFECO).
facts.L7_incentives: RESICO's 1–2.5% income tax and 0% IVA on qualifying exported services.
facts.D1_id_document: INE voter credential, or your passport.

watch_out.text: Exported services outside the official list still pay 16% IVA.
Most people can't hold dollars in a Mexican bank account.
